drivingQuestion: Is an animal diseased in a single kidney a tereifa, and under what condition?
outcomeNote: The Western qualification breaks off mid-clause at the end of the packet, so its content is not recoverable here.

segments.he: נִיטְּלוּ הַכְּלָיוֹת. אָמַר רָכִישׁ בַּר פָּפָּא מִשְּׁמֵיהּ דְּרַב: לָקְתָה בְּכוּלְיָא אַחַת – טְרֵפָה. אָמְרִי בְּמַעְרְבָא: וְהוּא דִּמְטַאי לָקוּתָא
segments.en: § The mishna states: If «the kidneys were removed» the animal remains kosher. «Rakhish bar Pappa said in the name of Rav:» If an animal was «diseased in» even «one kidney,» the animal is «a tereifa. In the West,» Eretz Yisrael, «they say: And this» applies only in a case «where the disease reached»
